What is C# and what is it used for?

C# is a strongly typed, object-oriented language developed by Microsoft for the .NET platform. C# 12 (.NET 8) is the current version.

Supports: functional programming, generics, async/await, component-oriented programming.

Tools: .NET SDK, Visual Studio, VS Code with C# Dev Kit, Rider.

```bash
dotnet new console -n MyApp
cd MyApp
dotnet run
```
